# `foxglove auth info`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](auth.md)

```text
Display information about the currently authenticated user

Usage: foxglove auth info [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
